consent.title: Turn on OpenAI models via OpenRouter
consent.body: Some OpenRouter models (OpenAI's GPT Image) are blocked by default by a privacy setting on your OpenRouter account. In OpenRouter → Privacy → Zero Data Retention, turn the OpenAI toggle OFF. That lets OpenAI's endpoints run (they may retain your prompt). We'll open the page, then check whether it works. Don't want to? The Google (Nano Banana) models work with nothing extra.
consent.workingBody: OpenAI models via OpenRouter are on now.
consent.failHint: Still off. In OpenRouter → Privacy → Zero Data Retention, turn the OpenAI toggle off, then come back and press Check.
consent.inconclusive: Couldn't check right now — try again in a moment.
